note: Phase 8 of the Legislative levers re-evaluation (DECISIONS E-173): sourced facts for costing each licence at entry and at renewal. Fees are quoted from the fee regulations (a fee in fee units is converted at the value in fee_units); renewal_years is how often the licence is renewed. Staff time uses assumed_hours unless an item gives its own, sourced hours. Costs are worked out by alicia/scripts/licence_costs.py. Drafted by AI-assisted desk research; not yet checked by a person.

assumed_hours.basis: Assumed: no regulator publishes how long an application or a renewal takes (Service NSW and QBCC pages searched, 16 November 2026). An entry application means gathering identity, qualification and insurance documents, completing the form and, for some licences, attending in person (individual NSW contractor licences are lodged at a Service NSW centre); a renewal is mostly an online payment. Replace with a sourced figure where a regulator publishes one.
